what: Several vertical cards (20vw wide, 4:5) stand stacked, each overlapping the next by 80%. Divide the panel width by the card count, and the card in the cell under the cursor comes to the front and scales to .94x. Side cards shift sideways by 80 + (m−1)(42−m)/2 % according to distance m and turn outward on the Y axis by −45° − (m−1)×10° (max −100°), and the farther from the front, the further back they sit — all bouncing with .8s elastic.out(1, .75). Cards turned around show their back color plate. Below 767 the cards are 50vw, the front card is pulled to the panel center at .85x, and the card is chosen by finger position.

options.spread: Percent the adjacent section is pushed, default 80
options.turn: Angle the adjacent sheet turns (deg), default 45

note: Card width is --fx-card (default 20vw) and --fx-card-narrow (50vw). At first the center section is in front

from.where: index.html .bw-deck — original MwgEffect114: xPercent ±(80+(m−1)(42−m)/2), rotationY ±max(−100, −45−(m−1)·10), active scale .94 (phone .85), .8s elastic.out(1, 0.75), cell = ceil(x/width·n)
